protocol.primary: Paired deterministic D at 10,240 decisions, report each seed and mean/median differences; descriptive only.
protocol.secondary: linear equal cost, five costs, reliability, violation, action shares, sampled evaluation diagnostic only.
protocol.mechanism: GAE/value/return, gradient clipping and parameter deltas; matched first rollout, unchanged .95 baseline.
protocol.fixed: Same physical config/JAR, model initialization, trace IDs/payloads, gamma=1 and all PPO settings except lambda.
protocol.namespace: pilot_train and pilot_validation only; no confirmatory/test access.
protocol.decision_rule: No automatic protocol adoption or selection of best seed. Review all pairs; no superiority/significance claim.
protocol.prefix_scope: Pilot 10,240 vs 10,752 only. Prior .95 F proof retained. New lambda=1 F reuse not certified.
protocol.config_separation: JAR/trace config stays immutable v0.2; separate versioned learner specs contain full effective PPO and effective-config hash.

partial_episode.note: Unresolved includes future arrivals; decided tasks can also await outcomes. No success inferred.

instrumentation.note: EV and return statistics use each condition own GAE targets; not a common ground-truth critic accuracy metric.
